prompt_en: Create a declared-fictional near-future photorealistic crime still: robbery by forced property transfer inside a glass desert-observatory tram station during a violent sleet storm. A distinct adult offender faces an adult rare-map courier. Action: one adult offender initiates the taking and controls the coercive action; in this frame he grips the same red leather case. Ownership: one specific adult victim visibly owns holds or guards the targeted property; the courier grips the red case handle against her body. Simultaneously, the offender clamps the other side of that same red case and pulls it toward his own body. This is a credible coercive threat: force or a credible directed threat compels the victim during the taking; the raised steel crowbar points toward the courier. Transfer: cash bag phone wallet or other property visibly moves from victim control toward offender control; the same red leather chronometer case crosses between their opposed hands. Image 1 guides an adult station investigator with an oval face, dark eyes, softly arched brows, and long center-parted dark wavy hair. She remains secondary at the edge, pressing an emergency alarm; stranded commuters shelter behind glass. Use a 28mm eye-level environmental composition with all three adults readable, crisp hands and case handle, sodium-vapor pools, red signal beacons, and sleet-streaked glass.
negative_en: body distortion, fake-looking background, 3D render look, cartoon style, over-processed retouching, illustration look, distorted fingers, low resolution

semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: The frozen core governs the distinct adults, directed crowbar threat, same-case transfer, fictional setting, and secondary reference-guided investigator.
Aircraft operation is unrelated to the locked tram-station robbery and would compete with the property-transfer relation.
A medium-failure treatment would reduce hand, threat, and transfer-path readability.
This is the exact request-scoped hard visual obligation assigned to this independent arm.

decisions.rationale: A pose-study treatment could make the event read as staged posing instead of a forced transfer.
The frozen random concept already authors sodium-vapor and red signal lighting inside the sleet-bound terminal.
Documentary texture is already present in the frozen baseline and does not need candidate adoption.
The authored environmental frame prioritizes readable hands, case, threat line, and supporting investigator over a prescribed full-length study.
A fixed three-quarter crop could remove the shared property-transfer path or emergency-alarm action.
Stepping into frame adds an unrelated movement and risks confusing the offender-courier action.

preserved_evidence: A distinct adult offender faces an adult rare-map courier.
the offender clamps the other side of that same red case and pulls it toward his own body
an adult station investigator with an oval face, dark eyes, softly arched brows, and long center-parted dark wavy hair

authorial_decisions.decision: Use an eye-level environmental frame that keeps the two opposed hands, the directed crowbar, and the secondary investigator simultaneously readable.
authorial_decisions.rationale: The relation and the reference role must coexist without the supporting figure obscuring the transfer.

authorial_decisions.decision: Use sodium-vapor pools and red signal beacons reflected through sleet-streaked glass.
authorial_decisions.rationale: Separated practical light preserves the case, hands, adult faces, and threat line while sustaining the random station concept.

authorial_decisions.decision: Make the leather case, steel crowbar, wet glass, and damp clothing materially distinct.
authorial_decisions.rationale: Material separation supports native-scale ownership and mechanism recognition.
